messages:
ashley (PM): Hey team — quick design review ask. I wired a compact "scoped" badge into the API Keys list to show the permission surface per-key. Wanted feedback on visibility, copy, and whether this helps with the rotate/revoke mental model. Screenshot pasted: https://img.redwood/keys-badge-mock.png

marco (Design): Nice. I like the micro badge idea for quick scannability. Two thoughts: 1) color-coding needs clear meaning (green = read-only? purple = write?) 2) consider a hover/tooltip with full permission list; badges are too terse for complex scopes.

tess (Frontend): Hover tooltip seems doable. Also: keyboard users won't see hover — we should make the badge focusable (tab) and show an aria-describedby panel.

olivia (Accessibility): +1 to focusable. For ARIA: use role="button" on the badge and an aria-expanded toggle state that opens a small dialog with the scope list. Ensure aria-live announcements when a scope panel opens so screen reader users know context changes.

jin (Eng/Runtime): One implementation caveat — we currently don't return full scope expansion in list API by default (privacy/compliance). We can add a minimal field e.g., "scope_summary": "read, embeddings" to avoid returning full sensitive ACLs. Would that work for the UI?

ashley (PM): That sounds fine. UX-wise, I want to avoid exposing keys' full ACLs in places that could be copied accidentally. So summary + explicit "view details" modal on click is ideal.

marco (Design): Related copy suggestion for badge tooltip: "Scopes: read · embeddings · limited write". If the scope is very broad we should show a visual warning and surface a revoke/rotate CTA inline. Idea: small :warning: micro-icon when scope includes *admin* or "*".

tess (Frontend): Inline revoke/rotate CTAs are a bit heavy in the list. Maybe show a subtle kebab menu with actions and add a one-click "Rotate" icon for power users. For mobile we should ensure the badge and action menu don't overlap.

jin (Eng/Runtime): Agreed on kebab. Backend note: rotate operation currently returns the new secret once; the UI flow must show a single ephemeral copy box with clear copy-to-clipboard affordance and explicit "I saved this" confirmation before dismiss.

olivia (Accessibility): That ephemeral copy step needs focus management. When the rotate modal appears focus should go to the secret field, and screen readers should announce "New secret generated; you have one chance to copy it." Also the "I saved this" button should be reachable via keyboard and must not disable for screen readers.

ashley (PM): Copy for the rotate confirm modal — draft: "New secret generated. This is the only time we will show it. Copy and store it securely. If lost, rotate again." Any nits?

marco (Design): Replace "store it securely" with "save it now — we won't be able to show it again." Shorter. Also add a tiny helper link "how to store secrets" which opens docs.

tess (Frontend): UX nit: when rotating a key with broad scopes we should add a two-step confirmation: 1) Confirm you want to rotate 2) Reconfirm if scope contains admin/* because the impact might be service-breaking. Could be a checkbox that says "I understand this will invalidate tokens".

jin (Eng/Runtime): We already have a safety gate for deletion, but not for rotate. Implementing a checkbox is trivial. Backend logs should tag rotates for keys with admin scope for audit. ops-bot will record the audit event.

ops-bot: Audit event will be created for key rotate: key_id=abc123 scope=admin timestamp=2026-03-23T15:07:00Z

olivia (Accessibility): Empty-state for scoped keys page: make sure we include a short, actionable sentence and a keyboard accessible CTA. Example copy: "No scoped keys yet — create a key to limit access by scope." Add an aria-live polite region that updates after key creation.

ashley (PM): Good call. Also want to show a micro timeline in the key detail panel with last-used timestamp and the last rotation date. Helps SREs decide rotation cadence. Keep data minimal for privacy though.

marco (Design): Visual treatment: small timeline icon + "Last used 3d ago" under the key name. For keys never used show "Never used" with a muted tone. For keys unused >90 days show a soft flag "Consider rotating" with suggested CTA.

tess (Frontend): Sorting suggestion: default sort = recently used, but add a sticky filter to show "broad-scope" keys at top so admins can triage. UI should allow saving filters as a view. Implementation question: do we have an endpoint to filter by scope breadth?

jin (Eng/Runtime): We can compute a scope breadth metric in the service (simple cardinality + wildcard flag) and expose it as scope_breadth:int for indexing. That will support filters without heavy payloads.

ashley (PM): Final item: privacy/regulatory — don't show full scope strings in audit logs for orgs with compliance needs. We'll add a redact flag per-org. Jin to add opt-out.

jin (Eng/Runtime): Will add org-level redaction toggle. UI should reflect redaction: tooltip shows "Scope details hidden for your org" and provide a link to request access.

marco (Design): One last micro copy tweak for create-key modal: current label "Key name (optional)" -> change to "Key name (optional) — helpful for teams". Subtle nudge.

olivia (Accessibility): Ensure labels are programmatically associated with inputs. For visually hidden helper text use aria-describedby. Also test rotate modal with NVDA/VoiceOver.

tess (Frontend): I'll prototype keyboard interactions and the kebab menu. Expect PR by EOD Friday.

ashley (PM): Thanks all. Action items: Marco -> update mocks with warning icon variants; Tess -> prototype & PR; Jin -> scope_summary + scope_breadth + org redaction flag; Olivia -> usability checklist for rotate flow. I'll consolidate into the ticket and add acceptance criteria. :thumbsup:
